name: moving-average
label: moving average
description: Averages a reading over the last N messages.
help: Averages `msg.payload`, or another property, over the last N messages and sends the average on with a `samples` count. The window lives in the plugin's own memory, so a redeploy starts it empty.

props.name: window
props.label: Window (messages)
props.help: How many of the latest readings to average.
